description: Explain where OTP sits in the market and why it is not the same thing as the tools it gets compared to (meeting and conversation intelligence, operating-system software, project management, HR systems). Call this when someone asks how OTP is different, who it competes with, why it is not just another meeting tool, or what category it is in. Public positioning material. Does NOT carry pricing strategy, deal terms, or roadmap.
name: otp_positioning
title: How OTP is positioned against the alternatives
